PCI.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

finding_categories.vulnerability: Apply patches within PCI DSS defined timelines (30 days for critical)
finding_categories.misconfiguration: Correct configuration to meet PCI DSS requirement
finding_categories.crypto: Ensure encryption meets PCI DSS strong cryptography requirements
finding_categories.credentials: Implement strong access control and password policies per PCI DSS
finding_categories.iam: Follow PCI DSS access control requirements (least privilege)
finding_categories.data_breach: Activate PCI DSS incident response procedures

finding_categories.misconfiguration: Ensure data protection controls are correctly configured
finding_categories.crypto: Encrypt personal data at rest and in transit
finding_categories.iam: Implement data access controls per DPDP

finding_categories.vulnerability: Apply patches as part of vulnerability management
finding_categories.misconfiguration: Correct configuration to meet ISO control requirements
finding_categories.credentials: Implement access control and password management

finding_categories.vulnerability: Address vulnerabilities as part of security criteria
finding_categories.misconfiguration: Ensure configuration controls meet SOC2 criteria
finding_categories.iam: Follow access control and identity management

internal.note: Internal data should be protected but not regulated.

regulated.note: Regulated data has legal compliance requirements.
